Team — attaching a compact snapshot of Q4 bookings headroom by cluster (Q3_bookings_snapshot.xlsx). High level: we have ~28% headroom vs. target but concentrated in two late-stage opps that need stage hygiene.

What I need by EOD Tuesday (11/17):
- Each AE to confirm stage or move to commit (Won/Commit/At Risk) in HubSpot for any opp > $75k.
- For prospects we expect to commit this quarter, add a 1-line confidence note and expected close date.
- Update the attached Stage_Update_Template.csv for any stage shifts — I will use this for a quick rollup to finance.

Ben — looping you for visibility on any bookings that need finance pre-approval (discounts/credits).
Emma — if Alta can confirm whether the internal finance review timeline has shifted, that will materially change our headroom.

- Blue Harbor: Ben, please loop procurement and indicate any concession requests ASAP; flag anything needing my or finance approval.

I'll take these updates into the finance snapshot tonight. If we still show >20% headroom after your updates, we'll move to plan B (re-engage mid-market plays and add a two-week cadence of commit check-ins).

I want a 30-min sync Thu 11/19 10:00-10:30am PT to confirm final roll; calendar invite coming. If someone can't make it, reply here with a 1-line status.
